svg.aria-label: A next-word bench. Five word tiles reading 'the cat sat on the' sit on a rail with one empty slot. A read head slides over them, a stack of six layer plates stands behind, and a rack of six pistons lifts the candidate words mat, floor, sofa, bed, roof and moon to heights set first by their scores and then by their probabilities. A temperature knob reshapes the probabilities, a tape in front of the rack is divided into lengths that match them, and a pin stops at a random point on the tape to pick the next word.
